summary: Locked, Nix-resolved dependencies for Tectonic and TeX.

values.quickstart:
nix shell 'github:nix-purifiers/tectonic-purifier'
tectonic-purifier lock
tectonic -X build
values.language_tooling_setup: Run the supplied `tectonic` wrapper for editor builds. Native PDF and SyncTeX output use the prepared support files and format data. For a standalone document, `tectonic main.tex --synctex` produces the normal editor synchronization output. Launch dependent editor processes through `tectonic-purifier exec -- your-editor` when they need that environment.
